question: Does a guest (temp account) upload on zeroupload.com accept a single file over 66.8 MB, and is it kept 7 days or 120 days?
why: The temp account page shows 66.8 MB of storage and removal after 7 days, while the FAQ states 5 GB per file and 120 days for free or non-account files. Settling it needs an upload from a temp session, which only the operator can do.
